place_info.title: Dr. Jash Ajmera | Psychiatrist and Psychotherapist in Surat | Sadbhav Neuropsychiatry Clinic
place_info.address: Someshwar Square, 208, opp. Aagam Heritage Bunglows, near University Road, Someshwar Square,Opp. Someshwar Enclave, Vesu, Surat, Gujarat 395007, India

reviews.snippet:
I had been struggling with severe sleep issues for almost six months, and it deeply affected both my physical and mental health. I felt exhausted, hopeless, and unsure if I would ever feel better again. Before meeting Dr. Jash Ajmera, I had consulted several neurologists, sleep specialists, and psychiatrists, but nothing seemed to work for me.

Then I visited Dr. Jash Ajmera, and his treatment truly made a difference. His medicines have been working really well, and I finally started seeing improvement in my sleep and overall health. I am extremely grateful to him for his care, guidance, and effective treatment.

Thank you, Dr. Jash Ajmera, for giving me hope again and helping me get my life back on track. I sincerely appreciate everything you have done for me.

reviews.snippet:
For the last 5 months, I was struggling badly with anxiety. I was scared to even step out of my house, and small things used to make me panic. I couldn’t sleep properly for months, and at one point, I even started having thoughts of giving up on life.
Then somehow, through ChatGPT, I got connected with Dr. Jash Ajmera. After just 2 months of treatment and medication, my anxiety completely changed for the better, and today I finally feel like myself again.
Thank you so much, Dr. Jash Ajmera. You truly changed my life.
